description.public:
Gadget · Engineer invention powered by Toolbelt scraps. Activate for 1 scrap; spend a 2nd scrap for the Toolbelt effect. Only Engineers gain the active benefit — an ally given this gadget gains only the Passive.

2 Actions (1 scrap): Requires a Firearm. Range 6, Blast 3. The area becomes Slowed Terrain for 1 minute or until dispersed. Creatures that start or end their turn in the area must make a STR save or be Restrained.

Toolbelt (2 scraps): Targets that leave the area are still Slowed, 2 turns.

Passive: You have advantage on Grapple (STR) saves.

[A] Using the gadget spends 1 Toolbelt scrap — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] Posts a STR save (fail: Restrained) — use its save button when a creature starts or ends its turn in the area.

[A] The Toolbelt upgrade is the separate "Glue Shell (Toolbelt)" feature (2 scraps total); the passive lives on the "Glue Shell" gadget feature, so it works even if this item is unequipped.

[A] Keep the gadget equipped: Nimble switches off an unequipped object's rules, so its scrap cost would not be charged.

[M] The area is Slowed Terrain for 1 minute or until dispersed.
